info.name: University of Alberta Research Data (Borealis Dataverse) Info Search API

params.name: q
params.description: Search query string. Use * to match all.

params.name: subtree
params.description: Dataverse alias to scope results. Use "ualberta" for the University of Alberta collection. May be repeated.

params.name: type
params.description: Restrict results to a single object type.

params.name: start
params.description: Zero-based offset of the first result to return.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort by (e.g. name, date).

items.docs: Searches datasets, dataverses, and files. Supports the same search, sort, and faceting operations as the web interface. Scope queries to the University of Alberta collection using subtree=ualberta.
